# Air Geronimo (Airie Mae Geronimo)

> Air Geronimo is a graphic designer and multimedia artist based in Metro Manila, Philippines, and a Multimedia Arts graduate. Air designs performance ad creatives, social media campaigns, brand identities, YouTube thumbnails, event collateral, and editorial layouts, and has worked professionally since 2019. Available for freelance, remote, and full-time design roles.

- Full name: Airie Mae Geronimo (goes by Air Geronimo; portfolio brand: Geronimuse)
- Title: Graphic Designer & Multimedia Artist
- Location: Metro Manila, Philippines (works remotely with clients worldwide)
- Languages: English, Filipino
- Contact: armgrnm@gmail.com
- Portfolio: https://www.geronimuse.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/airie-mae-geronimo-4aa204272/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/armgrnm/ (@armgrnm)
- Writing: https://hotcoffeegonecold.wordpress.com (personal essays since 2019)

## Services

- Performance ad creative for Meta, YouTube, and affiliate campaigns, including A/B variants
- Social media campaigns and content systems
- Brand and visual identity, logo design
- YouTube thumbnail design
- Event design and print collateral
- Editorial layouts, brochures, and training kits
- Illustration, 3D, motion graphics, and photography
- Website and landing page design

Tools: Figma, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe InDesign, Canva, video editing.

## Selected work

- Upcomers (2026): social campaigns, YouTube channel promotion, and brand and trust posts for a prop trading firm
- Upcomers x Hyperliquid (2026): partnership performance ads for the Thunderbolt, Oracle, and Horizon & Odyssey challenges
- UZO (2026): Flex challenge sale creatives and a Black Friday BOGO + free reset campaign
- Orion Funded: 250+ performance ad creatives for Meta, YouTube, and affiliate campaigns, with bilingual English-Spanish copy
- The Presidential Filipinnovation Awards 2025: event design suite (stage, backwalls, pull-up banners, rosettes, gift tags) and a 67-page training module kit
- Teleperformance Analytics Academy: enrollment ad creatives
- Ming's Dim Sum: trifold brochure
- Hidden Letters of the Heart: branding and marketing presentation for a poetry book
